info: Completed the ES module conversion: GUI.js fully ported to GUI.mjs (all classes, panels, menus and input helpers).
Added CSS class list helpers (addClass, removeClass, boolClass, ...) to StringUtils.
Exported i18xExpression from the i18x module.
Added release history support: releases.json loading, automatic i18xe registration of info texts and console output.
Added the packaging build (gulpfile.mjs): minimized distribution via build filter, JS cleanup and terser plus zip artifact.
Completed JSDoc for GUI.mjs: all 12 classes and every public member documented (audio inputs, SoundCloud, buttons, modal dialogs, progress bar, slideshow).
Restructured the project: library and reference app moved to src/, internal check scripts to dev/checks, legacy sources to dev/legacy; fixed the app.mjs import paths.
Initial .mjs module set (Config, System, i18x, StringUtils, DateUtils, ObjectUtils, Sounds, ...).
